title: Released my iOS app made with Claude
author: Scarfaceb1tch
selftext:
Just launched YarnBrook in iOS today. Workflow was several weeks iterating with Claude and using godot MCP for the engine. Assets were researched by Claude and then purchased to ensure everything stayed in the same style. Let me know what you think! 

 https://apps.apple.com/us/app/yarnbrook/id6816695601

comments.author: because-potato
comments.body: I would be amazed if you didn’t get sued by Nintendo. They are pretty sue-crazy, and this is strikingly similar to animal crossing. If this lifts off and gets a significant amount of attention, be ready for the cease and desist.

replies.author: Scarfaceb1tch
replies.body: That was definitely a concern but I made sure not to use anything that was copy written material or direct from AC. Plus this has a lot more focus on actual farming which isn’t even a game component in AC.

replies.author: because-potato
replies.body: The trees, clouds, houses, character model, day/night cycle, are all 1:1 copies.

replies.author: tractiv
replies.body: Wdym the clouds are copies, as if Nintendo invented clouds made out of round shapes. Also day night cycle? Can they really sue OP for implementing the sky going dark at night?

replies.author: Charles211
replies.body: This is just an ignorant statement.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body:
1:1 means direct copies , while they look similar, they aren't 1:1 . this is palworld vs pokemon level of a clone really. the games are pretty close in feature and style, but different enough where they might not be infridging on anything. that said nintendo can try and a single developer wouldn't have the ability to do anything

https://preview.redd.it/3712dep8d7wh1.png?width=590&format=png&auto=webp&s=21259a0089736e87d0c953d4ee1a2473900a5742

replies.author: heavy-minium
replies.body: Strikingly similar is a bit of a generous understatement, lol.

comments.author: raiadi
comments.body: Okay looks pretty. i would definitely download and try this game.

replies.author: Scarfaceb1tch
replies.body: Glad to hear that! It’s only iOS right now but will be porting to Android and also working on steam page currently

comments.author: TriggerHydrant
comments.body: Looks great! Well done wishing you success :)

replies.author: because-potato
replies.body: Just curious, why be in this sub if you hate AI games?

comments.author: AshAtlasDev
comments.body: Knock off animal crossing ayo. GL with Nintendo xD

comments.author: Latter-Park-4413
comments.body: Several weeks? Doesn't honestly sound like much effort tbh. I'd assume a good game, even fully AI made, would be iterated on for several months at the least. Looks good though - yes the AC vibe is undeniable - and if the game play is good, then whether it was weeks or months doesn't matter. GL.

replies.author: Psychological-Key-36
replies.body: Bad assumptions, some indie gems have been prototyped in the span of a 2 days game jam at the time of no AI so imagine the time it takes now with a clever idea

comments.author: Scorchyy
comments.body: How much did it cost to make?

replies.author: Scarfaceb1tch
replies.body: 3 months of the $200 max plan with Claude and about $120 in assets and music sfx etc. wanted to use Jon gen AI for the art aspects

replies.author: Scorchyy
replies.body: Seems expensive, are you expecting to make any money back?

replies.author: Scarfaceb1tch
replies.body: That would be nice but I enjoyed making it and am enjoying playing it in my free time so it was worth it to me. I’d be lying if I said that the whole Claude sub was fully for this as I did utilize other agents during the timeframe for other projects I’ve got going so not entirely spent on this game.
